sources.title: QuerynAi/queryn-adapter-ada-002_to_qwen3-emb-8b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Queryn adapter — ada-002 → qwen3-emb-8b Translates an embedding produced by ada-002 into the embedding space of qwen3-emb-8b, so a corpus already embedded with ada-002 can be served against a qwen3-emb-8b index without re-embedding it. Part of the Queryn embedding-translation engine.

sources.title: Queryn/docs/Adapters.md at main · Gigadelux/Queryn · GitHub
sources.snippet: Add any new embedding model to EMBEDDING_MODELS first if needed. Run dataset_splitting.py to produce a fresh data/splits/ {train,test}.parquet. Point a training pipeline (v1_adapter_model_training.py or later) at the new splits and run it — resumability means a crash or Ctrl-C just picks back up from the first unfinished pair.
